articles.title: Former Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to insider trading scheme on Hyperliquid
articles.snippet: Huaisong Xiang admitted using confidential crypto listing information to make $125,523 trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid.

articles.title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
articles.snippet: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

articles.title: Bitcoin crashes to 3-month low below $63,000 as analyst flags fourth capitulation wave
articles.snippet: "They are now selling at the very price they wish they had taken advantage of three months ago," wrote James Check.

articles.title: Nvidia shares fall 4% as board reportedly rules out Huang return
articles.snippet: The chipmaker’s board is reportedly focused on investigating Huang’s conduct, even as a petition calling for his reinstatement gathers more than 187,000 signatures.

articles.title: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases
articles.snippet: Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation.
